comparison.objective: Measure shaft end play, select/install a split spacer and verify corrected travel; candidate depins a terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Indicator referencing, two-stop measurement, part selection, split-spacer insertion and verification versus tab access and extraction.
comparison.success_condition: Measured travel corrected to 2–4 mm, spacer retained, shaft rotated and assembly stable; candidate requires selective removal without damage. Candidate force/damage thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Metrology-guided fitting tests abilities absent from the candidate.
